architecture: GCNConv -> ReLU -> GCNConv -> ReLU -> GCNConv -> Linear
activations: torch.relu applied to intermediate convolutions. The final GCN layer (conv3) output DOES NOT pass through ReLU.
forward_logic: Passes Data.x and Data.edge_index explicitly. Note that Data.edge_attr is implicitly ignored because GCNConv does not consume edge features.
